dialog.gestures.warning_msg:
⚠️ Warning: Enabling trackpad gestures may interfere with system gestures.

To avoid conflicts, disable the following macOS options:

• 2-finger trackpad gestures: disable scroll and swipe if you want to use them in Hammerspoon.
• 3-finger trackpad gestures to move windows and select text
• 3-finger tap to look up words in the dictionary
• 3-finger horizontal/vertical swipe to switch spaces, activate App Exposé or Mission Control
• 4-finger horizontal/vertical swipe to switch spaces, activate App Exposé or Mission Control

It is important to disable 4-finger system gestures in order to define 5-finger gestures. Otherwise, macOS would not distinguish between them and would prevent 5-finger gestures from working. That is why the default 4-finger gestures are redefined in the Gestures module to restore system functions without conflict with 5-finger gestures.
